parameters: Sweetest apples in Nova, picked at dawn!
Cabbages, leeks, turnips - the harbor cooks buy them all.
Buns from the Golden Crust, still warm!
Charms and rings with real enchantments.
Not one of them is cursed. Probably.
Capes for heroes, aprons for bakers.
I measure twice and cut once.
A ribbon for your sister? Midnight blue?
Ha! She was here last week, eyeing that one.
There you are. She has good taste, your sister.
Capes for heroes, aprons for bakers.
I measure twice and cut once.
Your friend with the katana would know its value.
Herbs for every ill - poison, sleep, paralysis.
Every child in Nova owns one of my bears.
Careful! You break it, you buy it.
Roast on a skewer, two coppers!
The magic shop sells potions that glow in the dark.
No curfew in Nova, but the Captain
likes honest folk indoors by midnight.
Fish is cheaper down at the harbor, mind you.
Keep an eye on your purse.
A thief has been seen near the stalls.
I didn't take anything! ...Want to buy a ring?
Out this late? Mind the alleys -
the market thief works nights too.
Woof! The puppy wags its tail.
The cat is guarding the well. Or sleeping.
Come inside! We have cats, hounds and an owl
Somebody call the guard! There's a fight by the shops!
Hey, you in the strange clothes!
What do you think you are doing?
Step aside. I saw that man stealing.
Listen, miss. This man is someone I know.
There's no way he stole from you.
Hmph. Thieves always cover for each other.
Tch. Guess I've got no choice.
No brawling inside the city walls!
